title: When faith becomes your language, fear forgets how to speak.
paragraphs:
When faith becomes your language, fear forgets how to speak.
Your strength isn’t in what you see…
It’s in the One who speaks peace into your storm.
Choose the voice of faith today—watch fear lose its fluency.

“For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.”
— 2 Timothy 1:7 (NKJV)
